dct_description_sm: We have assessed *primary and secondary roads* for signs of road blockages in the *Rasuwa, Nuwakot and Kathmandu* regions in Nepal. **Brief Overview: 28/08/2026 Dataset** -We found 22 road blockage locations (19 of these locations were severely flooded) -The NH42 road was highly impacted by flooding, and parts of NH03, NH18 and F181 roads were affected by flooding. -The data is held in a point shapefile format in WGS 84 EPSG: 4326. *This dataset is derived from crowd sourcing. The next data release is planned for 03/09/2026.* You can find the Planetary Response Network: Nepal Flash Flooding 2026 project we ran [here](https://www.zooniverse.org/projects/alicemead/planetary-response-network-nepal-flash-flooding-2026).
